description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants [ATK, MAG and MND 30%, DEF and RES 25% (25s)], [Quick Cast], and [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1], grants Awoken Sky Pirate Dancer Mode and Weak Dance to the user
Awoken Sky Pirate Dancer Mode: Unlimited White Magic/Dancer Hones, Quick White Magic/Dancer & chases R1/2/3/4/5 White Magic/Dancer abilities with h10/15/25/35/45 heal to all allies
Weak Dance: After using White Magic/Dancer abilities, grants [Weakness +30% Boost 1] to all allies (max 3 chases)
